title: Rebuild the Edge Scrum workspace and development workflows
acceptance: A fresh Edge session can query PI-01 sprint 1, create and revise a draft, append a note, link it to a work item, run 0.1 server and browser QA, and publish a PDF using the documented commands.
evidence: Baseline 3a48abb plus `manual`, `validate`, `receipt` and a 12-test suite. Verified: `npm test` 12/12, MCP initialize/tools/list/tools/call, `Run-EdgeTool.ps1 qa 0.1`, `browser 0.1`, `publish.py --changed`, and `validate` returns `ok: true` with 24 records. Limits: no FoundationOS UI yet; planning, control and access operations deferred; owner acceptance pending.
